headline: MPS Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - MPS Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the First Motion Order passed by the Honble National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench, in relation to the Scheme of amalgamation of ADI BPO Services Limited with MPS Limited.
